remarks: Completely renovated 1 bedroom in the heart of Wall Street! - Stunning apartment with newer kitchen featuring shaker-style cabinets, stainless steel appliances, and quartz counters! - Exposed brick! - 1.5 updated bathrooms featuring a subway-tile shower - Hardwood floors throughout & great natural lighting! - 2 level unit with bedroom on 2nd floor - Bedroom features a walk-in closet, en suite bathroom, and custom metal & cable railings - Private washer / dryer in unit! - Walk to multiple restaurants and coffee shops in the Wall Street neighborhood - Street parking + Off-street parking available through city parking lot - Hot water included in rent - No pets!
